title: Sebastian and the Horizon
author: Odile Oyelaran
blurb: Ivo Thornbury, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, has spent twenty years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
